name: hopf_conjecture_positive_curvature

phase_0.boundary_condition: Hopf conjecture statement: compact even-dimensional Riemannian manifolds with positive sectional curvature have positive Euler characteristic

VINIT.justification: Initial state before assigning any properties

TANCH.justification: Closed boundary containing the entire logical system

AFWD.justification: Forward transformation from curvature to Euler characteristic

AREV.justification: Reverse process seeking manifolds violating the conjecture

CLINK.justification: Composition linking curvature integrals to topological invariants

IMSCRIB.justification: Recognition of the manifold as a distinct mathematical object

FSPLIT.justification: Splits into verification path (true) and refutation path (false)

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes the original conjecture's truth value from branch outcomes

EVALT.justification: Affirmative evaluation confirming the conjecture holds

ENGAGR.justification: Simultaneous holding of both possible states without resolution

phase_3.void_description: Manifold without assigned curvature or Euler characteristic properties
phase_3.true_description: Conjecture verified: positive curvature implies positive Euler characteristic
phase_3.false_description: Conjecture refuted: counterexample with positive curvature and non-positive Euler characteristic exists
phase_3.both_description: Undecided state: conjecture remains open with neither proof nor counterexample

steps.domain_action: Establish Hopf conjecture as system boundary
Bifurcate into verification and refutation paths
Apply forward implication from curvature to Euler characteristic (T-arm anchor)
Compose curvature properties via Gauss-Bonnet theorem (T-arm)
Search for counterexamples violating the conjecture (F-arm anchor)
Record unresolved status in mathematical literature

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — No state change occurs without conclusive proof or counterexample
